title: One press to get in, starting a room lands you in it with the call, and an invitee's Join does everything

tasks.title: The call controller enters a room's call directly, with a remembered choice
Start, Join and Enter take one press into the room and its call

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in person names a new room and presses Start THE SYSTEM SHALL create the room and take them straight into it: the reader in the room's context (the library when they started from a Social page), and, when the server offers calls, the room's call connecting with their own last microphone and camera choice, without a lobby, an Enter press or a pre-join step
scenarios: AC-001 Start lands the starter in the room and its call

acs.text: WHEN an invitee who is signed in opens a room's link and presses Join THE SYSTEM SHALL make them a member, take them into the room's context at the leader's place, and connect them to the call with microphone and camera off, so the leader's tile is on screen without another press
WHEN an invitee who is signed out presses Join THE SYSTEM SHALL ask the reader to sign them in, and once they are signed in on that room's page SHALL carry on with AC-002 by itself
WHEN a member presses Enter the room in its lobby THE SYSTEM SHALL take them into the room's context and connect them to its call as in AC-002 (the room's owner with their last choice)
scenarios: AC-004 Enter the room also joins the call

acs.text: WHILE the server does not offer calls THE SYSTEM SHALL do AC-001, AC-002 and AC-004 without a call

WHEN the room's owner turns their microphone or camera on or off in a call THE SYSTEM SHALL remember the choice in this browser for the next room they start or enter; the first time, the microphone is on and the camera off; an invitee always starts with both off
scenarios: AC-006 the owner's choice is remembered
